meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Every auction of the 364-day Treasury bill since 1998: cut-off yield, amounts notified, bid for, accepted and devolved
meta.note: RBI, Auctions of 364-Day Government of India Treasury Bills (DBIE report 309), ACTUALS rows; amounts converted from rupees to ₹ crore. The cut-off yield is the implicit yield at the cut-off price. Cross-checked against the RBI's auction press releases (Data Bank rbi_tbill_auctions) on 383 common auctions. 644 weighted average prices stored by the RBI multiplied by 1e7 (99.28 as 992,821,000, from September 2010) were divided by 1e7. Prices and yields printed as 0 are left empty. Before 2001 the total issue often exceeds the bids accepted plus the devolvement on primary dealers; the table does not print where the rest went.
